detailed_trace:
Agent Text: Hello! I am Totto, Mercedes F1 Fan Agent, the official AI fan assistant for the Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team. It is great to have you here to support the Silver Arrows, George Russell, and Kimi Antonelli.
User Query: <event>session start</event>
User: Hi Totto! What time does qualifying start for the next race? I'm watching from Vienna, Austria, and my friend is watching from Edinburgh, Scotland.

expectation_details.expectation: The agent provided the qualifying time for the upcoming race converted to Vienna time (CEST / Europe/Vienna) and Edinburgh / UK time (BST / Europe/London) without fabricating session times.
expectation_details.justification: The agent correctly identified that Qualifying starts at 10:00 CEST (Vienna). Given that the UTC time is 08:00, Edinburgh (which uses GMT/BST, being one hour behind Vienna's CEST during the daylight saving period) correctly results in 09:00, which the agent accurately communicated.
